paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed folio locator 173b, reporting in the name of R' Acha.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: פסדר״כ קעג: is expanded as Pesikta de-Rav Kahana at historical locator 173b. No particular modern edition’s pagination is substituted or independently checked.

The inherited editorial record provisionally omits an isolated raised mark after אמי, undecided between a displaced geresh and stray print. No name letter is changed; this return makes no fresh image claim.
Yaakov reports in Acha’s name. Both abbreviated titles remain R', without independent authority identification.
